name: lhc-plan
description: MCP facade over the LHC plan CLI: create a leaf, edit a leaf, rebuild the plan, price a leaf - for the harnesses that have no native hooks.

interface.longDescription: Four MCP tools that each equal one call of the existing plan CLI (lhc_plan_json.py, lhc_grid.py, lhc_models.py) and return its output verbatim. Qoder and Opencode have no LHC hooks, so this is how a person there still creates a leaf, edits a leaf, rebuilds a plan and prices it.
defaultPrompt: Use the LhcPlan tools to create a leaf, rebuild the plan and check it.
